key_idea: Split questions into those where you agree with the friend and those where you differ; the friend's correct answers should be placed on agreeing questions as much as possible.
sketch: Let s be the number of positions where the answers match and n-s where they differ. If the friend has k correct, you gain on a matching question when the friend is right and on a differing question when the friend is wrong. Maximum is min(k, s) + min(n-k, n-s). O(n). Pitfall: forgetting the second term, i.e. that the friend's wrong answers must also be distributed.
